name: mapping-constructor-expr-test-833706cb84/spread-op-field-v.bal
spec_references: Expressions: Mapping constructor — Currently [spread-field](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#spread-field) not supported
reason: The assertions require mapping spread fields to copy map and record entries, including function-returned mappings, constant/global mappings, records with never fields and rest descriptors, and defaulted target record fields. Spread fields are explicitly unsupported.
unsupported_constructs: Mapping-constructor spread fields such as {...m1}, {...fn(), f: 123.4}, and {...rec1, ...rec2}
